purpose: root-cause evidence for V1.2 replay P0_FAIL (repeated build digest mismatch)
constraint: no parent artifacts touched; all opt calls counted in budget_ledger.json

experiments.name: diagA_gradient_repeatability_no_step
experiments.design: 3 consecutive load_checkpoint + gradient builds on window 0, no optimizer.step
experiments.conclusion: bit-reproducible within process without intervening optimizer.step

experiments.name: diagB_exact_replication_with_steps
experiments.design: real replay.build_update twice (each includes optimizer.step), real Ledger accounting
experiments.conclusion: reproduces the P0 failure; each build individually a valid AdamW step

experiments.name: diagC_causal_step_pollution_test
experiments.design: h0=load+grads; one isolated optimizer.step; h1=load+grads (1 opt call, ledger-counted)
experiments.conclusion: step does not pollute; gradient bytes differ ACROSS processes (8d3a0dcb != 0b949b26) while stable within this process

experiments.name: diagD_pure_load_state_representation
experiments.design: zero GPU cost: optimizer state_dict byte digest after load#1 vs load#2 (CPU)
experiments.conclusion: repeated loads give identical state representation; not the cause

delivered_replay_failure.interpretation: weights were bit-identical (0.0) but gradient/optimizer-state byte SHA differed; in diagB even weights differed (8.2e-6)

root_cause_assessment: gradient-build bytes on this GPU stack (RTX 4060 Laptop, torch 2.6.0+cu124, BF16 autocast, SDPA attention) are not bit-stable across processes and not guaranteed within a process across heavier allocation histories; kernel-level mechanism NOT_IDENTIFIED (atomics-class nondeterminism plausible but unproven)
implication: child P0 demands SHA-equality repeatability, stricter than parent protocol tolerance-based P0 (fp32_atol=1e-7 + rtol), which each build satisfies (3e-8); the gate is effectively unachievable on this stack as written
verdict: four-state counterfactual measurement blocked by engineering reproducibility gate; scientific question UNRESOLVED
